comment: * The handler to deal with the serious application errors.

methods.name: boolean handleApplicationWtf(IBinder app, String tag, boolean system, ApplicationErrorReport.ParcelableCrashInfo crashInfo, int immediateCallerPid)
methods.comment:
* @param app object of the crashing app, null for the system server
         * @param tag reported by the caller
         * @param system whether this wtf is coming from the system
         * @param crashInfo describing the context of the error
         * @param immediateCallerPid the caller Pid
         * @return true if the process should exit immediately (WTF is fatal)

methodNames: boolean handleApplicationWtf(IBinder app, String tag, boolean system, ApplicationErrorReport.ParcelableCrashInfo crashInfo, int immediateCallerPid)
